name: single leg stand on bosu ball
description: A balance hold on one leg on an unstable bosu ball. It challenges the ankle and hip stabilisers.
instructions: Place a bosu ball dome-up in front of you.
Step onto it with one foot near the center.
Lift your other foot and hold it off the ground.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.
